decisions.reason: As a multi-model dental product line launched with its own page and strong fit with the firm's core workflow offering, several years of continued commitment make management unlikely to withdraw it now.
This thermoforming blank supports the firm's established laboratory materials business, and sunk development and commercialization effort favor continuing rather than reversing course.

Although this lower-profile accessory product is more disposable than the others, management would still tend to keep it as a complementary item and explain any weak results as temporary or channel-related.
The custom earmold line sits close to the firm's custom-device capabilities and hearing-care channels, so accumulated investment and strategic fit encourage ongoing support.
